text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, and... up!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I still can't believe it...
To think everyone sent me so many letters!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Your last race was amazing, Kiseki-san!
Even though you were running as a front-runner,
you just kept picking up the pace...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"When was the last time I got that hyped up?!
Good luck in your next race too—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is the person who's been sending me letters all this time! To think they watched that race, too...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I really am... one lucky girl.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um, the next letter is... Ah—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"‘We can't wait for your next Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
We know you'll put on a fiercely dramatic show, Kiseki-san... We believe in you!’"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... gh!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Hehe, amazing!
Running alongside you, I can really feel that surging momentum!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You're getting so much stronger, Kiseki!
Guess working hard toward the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is really paying off!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! ...Y-Yeah!
After all, I've been training with Blast-chan all this time!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm in absolute peak condition right now!
Beyond a miracle—a super miracle, you could say!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's incredible!
Looks super strong!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Boo can't afford to lose either!
...See ya!
Thanks for matching my pace today!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...So this is the ultimate condition, huh.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true.
...This is probably the best I can do.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (...I've done everything I could possibly do.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I studied overseas races. I increased my training intensity. I experienced the local track conditions.
...Yet, I know.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even as I am now, I still can't win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With running like mine,
a piece that moves everyone is just--

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ……Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Stop it, stop it! Don't dwell on your weak self!
Squeeze out even just one idea...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, I'll deliberately hold back in the rear.
Make them think I'm running away, while saving as much stamina as possible—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, do I really stand a chance?
Going toe-to-toe in a sprint against Europe's finest...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then, I'll stick to the race favorite
like glue and...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... there's no guarantee
you'll get your ideal position, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Damn it,
I can't come up with a single good strategy...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The one staring intently at the tablet over there
...is that Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I double-check the training menu I've reviewed countless times.
There's very little time left until the representative exchange match...
choice_data_list: I'll make it to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...You really are aiming to win after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
...She's been doing so well lately, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... the Trainers
are actually more worked up than me—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still—if I can sprint through a downpour
on a heavy track, I know I can create
some blazing drama!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, without a doubt!
This 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' will go down as a masterpiece in history!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...What am I thinking?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's not right.
...That's not how it is.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The one who becomes the protagonist... has to be me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the final adjustments on the training menu,
just as I was about to head back to the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please race against me in the next Representative Exchange Match!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I don't surpass you all...
I'll never be able to create a work that truly moves people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So please, let me challenge this—
on my pride as a creator!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know her circumstances. But,
the eyes looking at me were so breathtakingly
serious..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you so much! ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm putting everything I have into this race—
to become the main character!
